issues.on_page: Local 165,704 (Exhibit F); Exhibit D General column (p4): Interest 108,320, Charges for Services 51,923, Miscellaneous 2,225
issues.issue: The broad 'Local' line is put in other/miscellaneous revenue, but the fund's own Exhibit D column shows interest is about 65% of it. Under the broad-line rule the dominant category applies: investment income (detail investment income), with review naming the mix. That the groups don't tie exactly (3,236 gap) doesn't justify 'other'.

The category rules put noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. The report prints it under Public Works, and this choice keeps the tie to the statement's function column. A judgment call.
